Gold.note: Central bank buying and rate cut expectations support prices despite highly elevated spot levels.

Silver.note: Robust solar panel demand offsets slight recent underperformance relative to gold.

Copper.note: Tight smelter treatment charges and strong grid investment offset broader macro headwinds.

Uranium.note: Structural supply deficit and renewed utility contracting drive long-term price support.

Lithium.note: Near-term oversupply from new capacity outweighs steady electric vehicle battery demand growth.

Nickel.note: Persistent Indonesian supply surplus and LFP battery substitution weigh heavily on prices.

Zinc.note: Tight concentrate supply from mine closures balances weak Chinese galvanized steel demand.

Iron Ore.note: Chinese property sector weakness continues to pressure demand despite infrastructure stimulus.

Coal.note: Thermal coal demand faces structural headwinds as global inventories remain adequate.

Rare Earths.note: Chinese export controls balance against currently soft electric vehicle motor demand.

Manganese.note: South African logistical bottlenecks are offset by broadly stable global steel production.

PGM.note: Modest auto production recovery is capped by catalytic converter substitution and weak Chinese sales.

Potash.note: Steady global agricultural application rates balance normalizing supply from Eastern Europe.

Aluminum.note: Chinese production capacity caps and strong renewable energy demand tighten the market.

Diversified.note: Heavy weighting in copper and gold provides a strong tailwind against base metal volatility.
